transcript.text: Build a personal media watchlist app that is FUN, not an Excel sheet: everything Evan needs to watch (anime, movies, live action, videos). Home page has a rotatable carousel of selectable title cards; each title gets its own page with a summary, hero image, IMDB link and more. Organize by genre/type (anime / movie / live action). Keep an intended watch ORDER. Add to the list. Review a title after watching, which checks it off as watched.

GREENFIELD — /home/corgea/Desktop/Coding Projects/media-list was an empty folder at enrollment (no git, no files). No existing code to map, brain-scan not applicable. Evan pointed at the sibling repo /home/corgea/Desktop/Coding Projects/repo-tour for his existing AutoDev identity (operator human:evan, preset solo-builder-review) — reused here rather than re-interviewing. Monitoring sidecar was ALREADY installed machine-wide (systemd user unit autodev-watch.service) watching roots '/home/corgea/Desktop/Coding Projects', which already covers this repo; nothing new installed.

ASSETS EVAN POINTED AT 2026-09-04: (1) PEXELS_API_KEY lives in '/home/corgea/Desktop/Coding Projects/GLP-Strong-App/.env.local' — reuse it for imagery. GLP's pattern to copy: fetch once, save under public/photos/, and record creator/license/source/alt in a credits.json (see GLP public/photos/programs/credits.json). (2) '/home/corgea/Desktop/Coding Projects/PROJECT_PORTS.md' is the port registry — media-list must claim a port there. Known-busy: 8833, 8765/6173, 8100, 8101, 8400, 8484, 8577, 8622/5622, 8642/5874, 8677, 7543, 7681, 7702, 7788, 5173, 5310/5311, 55433. 7777 is RESERVED-BY-BUG (a wrong health-check default makes any server there a false green).

DESIGN ANSWERS 2026-09-04 (Evan, verbatim intent): (1) ADD = search-and-pick, confirmed — type a title, pick from poster results, metadata auto-fills. (2) SCOPE = localhost only for now; phone access deferred to the GUTS Bridge if he ever wants it. (3) ORDER = ONE global queue, organizable/filterable by genre. Plus a SPIN-THE-WHEEL picker with a nice animation — he explicitly wants the animation quality. (4) GRANULARITY = a whole anime/series is ONE item. Explicitly NOT interested in episode/season splitting. (5) REVIEW = 5 stars, and watched titles go into a SEEN ARCHIVE. (6) CAROUSEL = click-and-drag to rotate AND side buttons to step. (7) STYLE = reuse repo-tour's modular style approach so new styles can be one-shotted. (8) STACK = FastAPI + Vite + SQLite, deliberately small. GitHub repo given as https://github.com/BMA-Corgea/medita-list (NOTE: spelled 'medita-list', folder is 'media-list' — needs confirming). MIT license. PRIVACY: the app is public, his watchlist CONTENTS are not — DB and personal data stay out of git. DB must self-create on startup if absent. CSV export AND import required.

DONE 2026-09-04 (pre-spec scaffolding): GitHub repo RENAMED medita-list -> media-list at Evan's instruction; https://github.com/BMA-Corgea/media-list, public, empty, remote wired as origin. git init'd locally (branch main). Wrote .gitignore (data/, *.db, *.sqlite, exports, .env — his watchlist contents never reach the public repo), .env.example, MIT LICENSE (copyright 'Evan' — surname unconfirmed), and .env chmod 600 holding TMDB_API_KEY (given by Evan this session) + PEXELS_API_KEY (copied from GLP-Strong-App/.env.local). TMDB key VERIFIED LIVE: search/multi 'cowboy bebop' returned HTTP 200 with posters+backdrops for the 1998 anime, the 2021 live-action, and the 2001 film. PROJECT_PORTS.md amended: media-list reserves 7799 (backend) / 5799 (Vite dev), loopback-only, added to the safe-side-by-side list. NEW REQUIREMENT IMPLICATION: Evan has NO existing list and intends to generate one by chatting with ChatGPT, so CSV import must be a RESOLVER (loose title/year rows -> TMDB search -> disambiguation review screen -> commit), not a strict-schema loader. Following .autodev/ committed-to-git convention from repo-tour.
